sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head rather pale red-yellow, rectangular, not narrowed anteriorly, about 2/3 as wide as long; the frontal margin, seen obliquely from behind, a uniform arc, rounded but not projecting as a protuberance; fontanelle large, exposed, squarish, with a ring of setae; labrum forked; mandibles slender, rather straight, incurved at the apex, shorter than the head, black with a yellow base; antenna 15-segmented, segment 1 thick and shorter than the following 3 segments together, segment 3 the smallest, segments 2 and 4 equal in length, the middle segments about 3 times as long as wide, narrowing toward the base; postmentum band-like, narrowing toward the base; pronotum much smaller than the hind lobe, very slightly concave in the middle, the hind lobe arcuate with a median longitudinal groove behind. Measurements: body length 10, head length including mandibles 5.45, head width 2.25 mm. The species is intermediate between Isognathotermes fungifaber and I. zenkeri, differing from both in the almost straight mandibles, incurved only at the apex, and in the fontanelle being open as in fungifaber (the vertex not projecting as a protuberance); it is clearly larger than fungifaber and almost as large as zenkeri.

note: Adapted from the original description by Sjöstedt (1913), original in German; soldier only; the type locality is Welgelegen, Katanga, Belgian Congo.
